input.summary:
Child's room B furnished in parts/room-12.mjs: red bed (head to the west wall, focal piece), desk (oak fence + oak slab) with a spruce-stair chair under the east windows, bookshelf with a lit candle and flower pot, barrel, red rug, two hanging lanterns under the loft floor.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt (room line: 16 placed, no REFUSED, no OFF-PALETTE). `mcd room` says OK: 28/28 cells walkable, min light 8, 0 dark. Ladder column x16 z21 and the hatch column x16 z20 are left clear.
Only the room's own floor/ceiling check was run for structure: no floating or unsupported blocks in the room box; the orphan slabs and logs listed by `mcd check` sit outside it, in other parts.

waste.what: Bed and stair facing conventions were worked out from memory of vanilla, then trusted. The toolkit says stairs' facing is the side of the full-height back, which I did not confirm against a render. The bed is head = foot + facing.
waste.cost: about 3 minutes of deliberation, no retries
waste.tool: mcd states + a one-line probe that places one bed and one stair and prints the cells, or a doc line in the toolkit fixing bed facing (foot to head) with a worked example

waste.what: Interior eye views: the first camera position (16,20,14) landed inside the door wall and showed only dirt; I re-aimed from inside the room on the second try.
waste.tool: mcd rooms --eye-from-door or a default interior camera per room (a corner of the room looking at its focal piece)

waste.what: Light placement was guessed (two hanging lanterns at y22 under the loft floor), then confirmed by the room check; no spot search was run before the first make.
waste.tool: mcd room --apply-lamps or a layers() preview that runs the light check on a draft before make.sh

waste.what: The rooms render shows one view only ('from above') at a size where the furniture is hard to read; the interior view needed a separate render command.
waste.tool: mcd rooms --views above,inside so one call gives both views the spec asks for

companions.task: Place and check the lantern and candle positions for the room before the first make.sh, so the room check passes on the first build.
Confirm the spruce-stair chair's facing (high back vs open front) against a render, since the toolkit's wording and my memory of vanilla differ.
Check that the desk (oak fence with an oak slab on top) and the bookshelf-and-candle shelf read as furniture from the doorway, then suggest a second piece if the room looks bare.

left: plan.md checklist and elements.md have no Child's room B entry, so I did not tick anything. I did not edit plan.md, since the other workers share it.

The rooms render gave one view ('from above') that is too small to judge the furniture; I checked the layout with the interior eye render (tiles2/inside-looking-at-the-bed.png) instead, which showed the bed, desk, chair, barrel and window reading correctly.
Chair facing follows the toolkit's convention (facing = side of the full-height back); not verified in a render beyond the interior view.
